dcf_check.cause: Terminal assumptions. At 9.0% WACC and 2.0% growth the Gordon value equals ~8.2x forward FY2031 EBITDA, ~1.3x below the 9.5x horizon multiple, which is itself 1.1x below the IPP median. The 2.0% was set to price the post-2029/30 PJM design, but that risk was also in the multiple discount, the flat FY2029-30 EBITDA path (+1%/yr) and the bear scenario: the 0.5pt cost ~$13.5/share of DCF against a probability-weighted PJM effect of ~-$3/share. The discount rate is not the cause (9.0% vs 8.0-8.4% implied, inside 3 points), and the 5-year window cannot be extended (engine cap) and is not needed: FY2028-30 growth is low by design.

judgment_calls_for_kilian.question: FY2028 power price and non-book rate: hedge increments at the curve of the deck where each first shows, less the 2027 gap on the same weighting, plus Meta, at the H1 2026 non-book rate (booked)?

FY2028 is 78% hedged and the deck does not publish the 2028 hedge prices, so each hedge increment (58% by 12-31-25, then +7, +7, +6 points to 78% at 10-30) is priced at the 2028 curve of the deck where it first shows (Kilian 2026-11-10), less the gap by which 2027 hedges came in below their own tranche-weighted 2027 curves (TX -6.99, East -1.46 $/MWh; the equal-average builds are sized as alternatives), plus the Meta nuclear PPAs at full delivery (+487 $M). Non-book items (coal, purchased power, delivery, PTC, dispatch) are actual generation EBITDA less what the book implied, per MWh.
